description: This file defines the Object API for netlink objects, including object structure macros, object operations, and comparison/dumping functions.

methods.name: nl_object_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new netlink object based on provided object operations.

methods.name: nl_object_put
methods.description: Decrements reference count and frees the object if no longer used.

methods.name: nl_dump
methods.description: Dumps information about a netlink object according to specified parameters.

methods.name: nl_new_line
methods.description: Prefixes a new line in dump output.

methods.name: nl_dump_line
methods.description: Outputs a line of dump information.
